# Quant Pricer

> Interactive web pricer for vanilla and exotic options. Black-Scholes-Merton closed-form, Reiner-Rubinstein barriers, Kemna-Vorst and Levy asians, Goldman-Sosin-Gatto lookbacks, plus Monte Carlo with Sobol quasi-random sequences and Brownian bridge.

All computations run client-side in the browser — no data is stored. Methodology and references match Bloomberg OVME.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview and entry points to each pricer.
- [Vanilla options](/vanilla): Black-Scholes-Merton pricer for European calls and puts, with analytical greeks, payoff and P&L charts.
- [Exotic options](/exotic): Barriers, asians, digitals and lookbacks priced via closed-form formulas or Monte Carlo, with greeks and simulated paths.
- [Methodology](/about): Models, assumptions, formulas and bibliographic references for every pricer.
